description.value: The Fairmont Empress is a landmark Edwardian chateau-style hotel that has stood on Victoria's inner harbour since 1908, making it one of the most historically significant grand hotels in Canada. Operating as a full-service luxury property with dining, a spa, fitness centre, and pools, it occupies a prime downtown location at the foot of Government Street directly across from the inner harbour and BC legislature grounds. Touring cyclists arriving in Victoria will find it at the geographic and symbolic heart of the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The fetched website content consists almost entirely of global Fairmont navigation menus; the property-specific subpages (guest services, dining detail, etc.) loaded only navigation and were truncated, yielding no cyclist-relevant amenity text. OSM confirms the hotel is real, open, and at 721 Government Street with internet_access=wlan; the website's dining navigation section explicitly lists Restaurants and Bars under the Dine section, confirming on-site evening food. No evidence for bike storage, tools, laundry, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears in either source.
concerns: Fetched website content for all subpages consisted almost entirely of global navigation menus with no property-specific amenity detail captured; cycling amenities (bike storage, Wi-Fi, laundry, etc.) could not be verified from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, iconic luxury hotel in Victoria's city centre; clearly useful to touring cyclists regardless of unconfirmed cyclist-specific amenities.
